card.name: Decimal digit in adverse-event percentages
card.fires_on: The digit after the decimal point in a percentage such as (2.1%) or (20.4%), mostly 1 or 4, in lists of adverse reaction or trial rates. It fires just before the % sign.

modes.label: Final digit in event rate lists
modes.description: The digit after the point in a small percentage that closes a parenthesis after a named adverse event.

modes.label: Digit in group comparisons
modes.description: The digit after the point in a percentage compared between treatment and control groups.

card.plain: It marks the last digit of a decimal percentage in side-effect or trial result tables.
